up: Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL5606461. For exact values, include rows where the standard_relation is '='. Return the canonical SMILES, the molecule ChEMBL ID, the standard relation, the standard value, and the standard units.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5606461')
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
